resources.string: A single tap on the orb activates your assistant.

Allows your assistant to perform tasks you request inside other apps, such as opening a chat, typing a message or adding to a cart, by reading the screen and tapping on your behalf. It acts only while a task you requested is running, displays a Stop button throughout, and asks for your confirmation before anything that sends, pays, orders or deletes. It never reads or types passwords or codes.
Tap and speak to your assistant
